tsconfig.json on every run and re-adds '.next/types/**/*.ts', so excluding
Why exclude .next at all: Next generates one type file per route under
.next/types but never prunes it when a route is deleted. A removed page
leaves behind a type file importing a module that no longer exists, which
reports as a permanent TS2307 that no source change can fix. A typecheck
of the source tree must describe the source tree.
Route types are still validated: `next build` type-checks them itself.
